messages:
maria: Heads-up  recruiters flagged ~22 interviews created this morning missing the new scorecard fields (resume-structure, code-sanity). Looks like the ATS webhook returned 202 but schema validation dropped extra fields.

lee: I see it in the QA dashboard. The importer silently ignores unknown fields after the schema bump. Those fields are present in GH payload but not wired to UI.

ash: can we do a non-destructive repair? prefer to attach the correct scorecard version only when scorecard_id is null.

tal: plan: export affected interviews -> dry-run a backfill that sets scorecard_id=scorecard-v3 and preserves original payload in metadata_legacy -> apply -> notify HMs.

maria: please include a small CSV sample in the thread before apply so hiring managers can spot-check. Also request a short interviewer refresher for the new fields.

recruiting-bot: export job queued (job=120045). ETA ~45s.

lee: export done: 22 rows. sample: C-990 INT-451 role=Data Infra created_by=loop-recruiter

ash: dry-run command:
```
python tools/ats_backfill.py --csv /tmp/missing_fields.csv --dry-run --set scorecard_id=scorecard-v3 --preserve-payload
```

ash: dry-run complete: 22 interviews would be updated. no overwrites detected. sample log: INT-451 -> set scorecard_v3 (preserve payload id=pl-990).

tal: ok to apply after maria posts a quick HM sample check. maria, can you roster 2 HMs for a 5-min thumbs-up?

maria: pinged HMs, they gave verbal OK. go ahead. also add a Slack alert to #people-ops when >10 interviews updated by a backfill.

ash: applying now. will include CSV of updated ids and trigger the alert.

recruiting-bot: backfill job started (bf-120045).

recruiting-bot: backfill complete bf-120045. 22 interviews updated. CSV: https://internal/files/bf-120045/updated.csv

lee: spot-checked 5 interviews, the new fields are present in the scorecard and previous payload preserved under metadata_legacy. good.

maria: follow-ups: 1) @people-ops schedule a 20-min interviewer refresh on resume-structure + code-sanity fields; 2) @infra add a schema-compatibility test to importer PRs to reject silent drops; 3) add nightly QA that alerts if >3 interviews have new fields present in payload but missing in UI.

tal: noted. I'll open infra ticket and add the Slack alert to the backfill job.

maria: thanks all. closing when calendar invite + infra ticket exist. :white_check_mark:
